name: Hisuian Goodra
flavor: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

ability.name: Securely Sheltered
ability.effect: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon takes −80 damage from that attack.
